title: 第15章 同窗情谊再寻师姐第16章 谢舟赠剑习三法
content_zh:
“《焚髓剑煞决》？师兄寻这虎狼法门作甚？”
江凝雪惊讶的问道。
此世修行之道极为昌盛，擎岳州亦是如此，故此除去凡俗之人外，大小宗门、世家层出不穷，诸般法门亦是多如繁星。
而蛰院弟子，是从整个擎岳州挑选而出的。
这些弟子中，自然有出身修行小家族，从小耳濡目染，知晓更多修行之事，拥有家传之法的。
只是一切法门，都不如鉴天教玄妙，故此一入鉴天教，都弃了家族之法，转修真正的仙教正法。
但不修，并不代表没有。
江凝雪就是出身一修行小家族，家中仅有两位采浊炁的修行长辈，实力低微，在修行界也仅仅是艰难求生。
所以江凝雪虽然炼炁失败，但也没想过回到家族，继承衣钵，家族也并不同意。
能在鉴天教扎根，就算此代不成，后代还有希望。
况且，鉴天教修行，极为安稳，胜过外界无数倍。
而她家族，就有一炼炁境的法门，名为《焚髓剑煞决》。
此剑诀一朝激发，迅如雷霆，稍逊一筹的法门皆不能阻，且一入敌修之身，就会吸髓食血，直至敌修身亡，极为霸道诡异。
但弊端也很明显，正如剑诀之名。
焚髓！
此剑诀一经修行，就会焚烧己身血髓，乃是杀敌一千，自损八百的酷烈之法。
不到万不得已，江家弟子是不会修行此法的。
江凝雪自从入了鉴天教，也未曾想过修行此法。
鉴天教煌煌正法，数不胜数，就算她炼炁失败，转修金甲玉躯，也有妙法可修，何苦修这焚髓的法门？
正是因为无所谓，她在蛰院修行胎息剑法之时，和同窗闲聊说过此法。

陆玄亦是因此得知。
但她没想到，陆玄二次大醮，前途光明，竟然会前来寻此法门？
陆玄闻言，也并未隐瞒：“师妹有所不知，我二次大醮得成，终究失了天时，故此需凭己身争一灵物，后日就得前去。”
“时日太短，已经来不及修行教内正法，故此只能寻速成法门。”
“至于此法危害，师妹无需担心，我自有定计，不会损了自身修行。”
江凝雪这才恍然，但随即又皱眉：“师兄刚刚炼炁，正是急需安稳修行的时刻，竟然此刻要师兄争灵物，我仙教气魄何时如此之短了？”
陆玄摇头轻笑：“仙教贵生，自然有其道理，此番我去争，虽有凶险，但也是一桩机缘，或可领先各师兄师姐一步……”
江凝雪这才脸色缓和：“原来如此。”
仙教贵生，但亦要以劳获得，能领先旁人一筹的灵物，确实需要一争。
一念至此，她没有犹豫，让陆玄稍待，而后走入后室，不多时就携着一张金册走了出来。
“我本以为此法在仙教之中无用了，故此就不曾随身携带，而是放于精舍之中，既然师兄想要，那就拿去一观。”江凝雪大大方方，直接将金册给了陆玄，但还是告诫了一句：
“我知晓师兄是个主意正的，既然师兄说无惧此法之后患，想必定有妙术，我仅得胎息，就不多问了。但此法着实酷烈，炼炁一重，至多催发三剑，否则血髓彻底焚尽，怕是寻常妙法难救。”
“多谢师妹！”
陆玄没有客气，结果金册，道谢了一声，同时袖袍一挥，取出一锦囊放在桌上。
“不能白白观看师妹家传之法，我这尚有九枚灵石，师妹且拿去买些灵物滋补。”
content_en:
""Marrow-Burning Sword Jue"? Why is Senior Brother looking for this tiger-wolf method?"
Jiang Ningxue asked in surprise.
The path of cultivation in this world is extremely prosperous, and the same is true in Qingyue Prefecture. Therefore, apart from ordinary people, sects and families, large and small, emerge in endlessly, and all kinds of Dharma doors are as numerous as stars.
The disciples of Zheyuan are selected from the entire Qingyue Prefecture.
Among these disciples, there are naturally those who come from small cultivating families, who have been exposed to it since childhood, know more about cultivating, and have methods passed down from their families.
It's just that all the methods are not as mysterious as the Jiantian Sect, so as soon as they joined the Jiantian Sect, they abandoned their family's methods and turned to the real Immortal Sect's righteous methods.
But not cultivating it doesn’t mean it doesn’t exist.
Jiang Ningxue was born in a small cultivating family. There were only two cultivating elders in the family who were capable of cultivating Zhuo Qi. Their strength was low and they were struggling to survive in the cultivating world.
Therefore, although Jiang Ningxue failed in refining Qi, she never thought of returning to the family and inheriting the mantle, and the family did not agree.
If we can take root in Jiantian Sect, even if this generation fails, there is still hope for future generations.
Moreover, the practice of Jiantian Sect is extremely stable, countless times better than the outside world.
And her family has a method in the Qi Refining Realm called "Burning Marrow Sword Jue".
Once this sword technique is activated, it is as fast as thunder, and no inferior technique can stop it. And once it enters the enemy cultivator's body, it will suck the marrow and blood until the enemy cultivator dies, which is extremely domineering and strange.
But the disadvantages are also obvious, just like the name of the sword technique.
Burn the marrow!
Once this sword technique is practiced, it will burn the blood and marrow of one's body. It is a cruel method that can kill a thousand enemies and damage oneself eight hundred.
Jiang family disciples will not practice this method unless absolutely necessary.
Jiang Ningxue has never thought about practicing this method since she joined the Jiantian Sect.
The Jiantian Sect has countless splendid methods. Even if she fails in refining Qi and turns to the Golden Armor and Jade Body, there are still wonderful methods to practice. Why bother to practice this marrow-burning method?
Precisely because she didn't care, when she was practicing the fetal breath sword technique in the dormitory, she chatted about it with her classmates.
Lu Xuan also learned about it.
But she didn't expect that Lu Xuan, who was having his second big feast and had a bright future, would come to seek this method?
When Lu Xuan heard this, he didn't hide it: "Junior sister doesn't know something. I succeeded in the second big ceremony, but I finally lost the opportunity. Therefore, I have to fight for a spiritual object by myself, and I have to go the day after tomorrow."
"The time is too short and there is no time to practice the righteous teaching within the teaching, so I can only find a way to achieve it quickly."
"As for the dangers of this method, junior sister, there is no need to worry. I have my own plan and will not harm my own practice."
Jiang Ningxue suddenly understood, but then she frowned: "Senior brother has just been practicing Qi, and it is the moment when we urgently need to practice stably. Now we are asking senior brother to fight for spiritual objects. When did the spirit of our Immortal Sect become so short?"
Lu Xuan shook his head and chuckled: "There is a reason for immortality to value students. This time I will fight. Although it is dangerous, it is also an opportunity. I may be one step ahead of my brothers and sisters..."
Jiang Ningxue's expression softened: "I see."
Immortal teachings value life, but they must also be obtained through hard work. Spiritual creatures that can be one step ahead of others really need to compete.
As soon as she thought about it, she did not hesitate and asked Lu Xuan to wait for a while, then walked into the back room and walked out after a while carrying a gold book.
"I originally thought that this method was useless in the Immortal Sect, so I never carried it with me, but kept it in the monastery. Since my senior brother wants it, let's take it for a look." Jiang Ningxue generously gave the golden book to Lu Xuan, but still warned:
"I know that senior brother has a good idea. Since senior brother said that there is no need to worry about the consequences of this method, I think there must be a wonderful skill. I can only get the fetal breath, so I won't ask any more questions. But this method is really cruel. One level of energy refining can activate at most three swords. Otherwise, the blood marrow will be completely burned. I'm afraid it will be difficult to save it with ordinary magical methods."
"Thank you, junior sister!"
Lu Xuan was not polite, so he thanked him for the golden book. At the same time, he waved his sleeves and took out a brocade bag and put it on the table.
"You can't watch Junior Sister's family tradition in vain. I still have nine spiritual stones. Junior Sister, please take them to buy some spiritual nourishment."
